slok.be:
উদ্ধরেদাত্মনাত্মানং নাত্মানমবসাদযেত্ |
আত্মৈব হ্যাত্মনো বন্ধুরাত্মৈব রিপুরাত্মনঃ ||৬-৫||
slok.en:
uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet .
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ ||6-5||
slok.hi:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् |
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ||६-५||
slok.ka:
ಉದ್ಧರೇದಾತ್ಮನಾತ್ಮಾನಂ ನಾತ್ಮಾನಮವಸಾದಯೇತ್ |
ಆತ್ಮೈವ ಹ್ಯಾತ್ಮನೋ ಬನ್ಧುರಾತ್ಮೈವ ರಿಪುರಾತ್ಮನಃ ||೬-೫||

verse_translation.life_application: Uplift yourself through your own mental discipline, refusing to degrade yourself, for you are your own friend or enemy.

commentary.text: 6.5 Let a man lift himself by his own Self alone, let him not lower himself; for the Self alone is the friend of self, and the Self alone is the enemy of self.

verse_translation.life_application: Knowledge is better than mechanical practice; meditation excels knowledge; surrendering action fruits excels meditation, bringing immediate peace.

commentary.text: 12.12 Knowledge is indeed superior to practice; meditation is superior to knowledge; and renunciation of the fruits of action is even superior to meditation; from renunciation, peace immediately follows.

slok.be:
যং সংন্যাসমিতি প্রাহুর্যোগং তং বিদ্ধি পাণ্ডব |
ন হ্যসংন্যস্তসঙ্কল্পো যোগী ভবতি কশ্চন ||৬-২||
slok.en:
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava .
na hyasaṃnyastasaṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana ||6-2||
slok.hi:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव |
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ||६-२||
slok.ka:
ಯಂ ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಮಿತಿ ಪ್ರಾಹುರ್ಯೋಗಂ ತಂ ವಿದ್ಧಿ ಪಾಣ್ಡವ |
ನ ಹ್ಯಸಂನ್ಯಸ್ತಸಙ್ಕಲ್ಪೋ ಯೋಗೀ ಭವತಿ ಕಶ್ಚನ ||೬-೨||

verse_translation.life_application: Understand that true spiritual practice requires giving up selfish planning and obsessive personal motives.

commentary.text: 6.2 Know that which is called sannyasa to be yoga, O Pandava; for no one becomes a yogi who has not renounced desire for the fruit of action.

slok.be:
শুক্লকৃষ্ণে গতী হ্যেতে জগতঃ শাশ্বতে মতে |
একযা যাত্যনাবৃত্তিমন্যযাবর্ততে পুনঃ ||৮-২৬||
slok.en:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate .
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ ||8-26||
slok.hi:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते |
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ||८-२६||
slok.ka:
ಶುಕ್ಲಕೃಷ್ಣೇ ಗತೀ ಹ್ಯೇತೇ ಜಗತಃ ಶಾಶ್ವತೇ ಮತೇ |
ಏಕಯಾ ಯಾತ್ಯನಾವೃತ್ತಿಮನ್ಯಯಾವರ್ತತೇ ಪುನಃ ||೮-೨೬||

verse_translation.life_application: Know these two eternal paths of light and darkness, one leading to liberation and the other to rebirth.

commentary.text: 8.26 Truly these two paths, the bright and the dark, are considered eternal for the world; by the one man goes to non-return, and by the other he returns again.

slok.be:
সঞ্জয উবাচ |
এবমুক্ত্বা হৃষীকেশং গুডাকেশঃ পরন্তপ |
ন যোত্স্য ইতি গোবিন্দমুক্ত্বা তূষ্ণীং বভূব হ ||২-৯||
slok.en:
sañjaya uvāca .
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ guḍākeśaḥ parantapaḥ .
na yotsya iti govindamuktvā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha ||2-9||
slok.hi:
सञ्जय उवाच |
एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप |
न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह ||२-९||
slok.ka:
ಸಞ್ಜಯ ಉವಾಚ |
ಏವಮುಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಹೃಷೀಕೇಶಂ ಗುಡಾಕೇಶಃ ಪರನ್ತಪ |
ನ ಯೋತ್ಸ್ಯ ಇತಿ ಗೋವಿನ್ದಮುಕ್ತ್ವಾ ತೂಷ್ಣೀಂ ಬಭೂವ ಹ ||೨-೯||

verse_translation.life_application: Observe your own urge to withdraw into silence when a challenge feels too heavy to carry alone.

commentary.text: 2.9 Sanjaya said: Having thus addressed Hrishikesha, Gudakesha the Parantapa said to Govinda, "I will not fight," and fell silent.

slok.be:
ব্রহ্মণ্যাধায কর্মাণি সঙ্গং ত্যক্ত্বা করোতি যঃ |
লিপ্যতে ন স পাপেন পদ্মপত্রমিবাম্ভসা ||৫-১০||
slok.en:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ .
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā ||5-10||
slok.hi:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः |
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ||५-१०||
slok.ka:
ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣ್ಯಾಧಾಯ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಸಙ್ಗಂ ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಕರೋತಿ ಯಃ |
ಲಿಪ್ಯತೇ ನ ಸ ಪಾಪೇನ ಪದ್ಮಪತ್ರಮಿವಾಮ್ಭಸಾ ||೫-೧೦||

verse_translation.life_application: Offer your work to the divine presence, remaining untouched by worldly troubles just as a lotus leaf repels water.

commentary.text: 5.10 He who performs actions, offering them to Brahman and abandoning attachment, is not tainted by sin, as a lotus leaf by water.

slok.be:
বন্ধুরাত্মাত্মনস্তস্য যেনাত্মৈবাত্মনা জিতঃ |
অনাত্মনস্তু শত্রুত্বে বর্তেতাত্মৈব শত্রুবত্ ||৬-৬||
slok.en:
bandhurātmātmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ .
anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat ||6-6||
slok.hi:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः |
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ||६-६||
slok.ka:
ಬನ್ಧುರಾತ್ಮಾತ್ಮನಸ್ತಸ್ಯ ಯೇನಾತ್ಮೈವಾತ್ಮನಾ ಜಿತಃ |
ಅನಾತ್ಮನಸ್ತು ಶತ್ರುತ್ವೇ ವರ್ತೇತಾತ್ಮೈವ ಶತ್ರುವತ್ ||೬-೬||

verse_translation.life_application: Master your mind so it becomes your best ally, rather than letting an undisciplined mind act as your worst enemy.

commentary.text: 6.6 For him who has conquered himself by the Self, his Self is a friend; but for him who has not conquered himself, his Self will act like an enemy in hostility.

slok.be:
চঞ্চলং হি মনঃ কৃষ্ণ প্রমাথি বলবদ্ দৃঢম্ |
তস্যাহং নিগ্রহং মন্যে বাযোরিব সুদুষ্করম্ ||৬-৩৪||
slok.en:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham .
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram ||6-34||
slok.hi:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम् |
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ||६-३४||
slok.ka:
ಚಞ್ಚಲಂ ಹಿ ಮನಃ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಪ್ರಮಾಥಿ ಬಲವದ್ ದೃಢಮ್ |
ತಸ್ಯಾಹಂ ನಿಗ್ರಹಂ ಮನ್ಯೇ ವಾಯೋರಿವ ಸುದುಷ್ಕರಮ್ ||೬-೩೪||

verse_translation.life_application: Recognize that the mind is turbulent, powerful, and stubborn, requiring patient effort to harness like the wind.

commentary.text: 6.34 The mind indeed is restless, O Krishna, turbulent, strong, and unyielding; I consider its control to be as difficult as controlling the wind.

slok.be:
শ্রীভগবানুবাচ |
লোকেঽস্মিন্ দ্বিবিধা নিষ্ঠা পুরা প্রোক্তা মযানঘ |
জ্ঞানযোগেন সাঙ্খ্যানাং কর্মযোগেন যোগিনাম্ ||৩-৩||
slok.en:
śrībhagavānuvāca .
loke.asmina dvividhā niṣṭhā purā proktā mayānagha .
jñānayogena sāṅkhyānāṃ karmayogena yoginām ||3-3||
slok.hi:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ |
ज्ञानयोगेन साङ्ख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम् ||३-३||
slok.ka:
ಶ್ರೀಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಲೋಕೇಽಸ್ಮಿನ್ ದ್ವಿವಿಧಾ ನಿಷ್ಠಾ ಪುರಾ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ತಾ ಮಯಾನಘ |
ಜ್ಞಾನಯೋಗೇನ ಸಾಙ್ಖ್ಯಾನಾಂ ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗೇನ ಯೋಗಿನಾಮ್ ||೩-೩||

verse_translation.life_application: Honor your own natural temperament today, choosing spiritual practices that align with your personality rather than copying others.

commentary.text: 3.3 Sri Bhagavan said: O sinless one (anagha) Arjuna, in this verse I have already declared two kinds of steadfastness (nishtha) -- that of the knowers (Sankhyas), reached through jnana-yoga, and that of the yogis, reached through karma-yoga.

slok.be:
অপ্রকাশোঽপ্রবৃত্তিশ্চ প্রমাদো মোহ এব চ |
তমস্যেতানি জাযন্তে বিবৃদ্ধে কুরুনন্দন ||১৪-১৩||
slok.en:
aprakāśo.apravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva ca .
tamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana ||14-13||
slok.hi:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च |
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ||१४-१३||
slok.ka:
ಅಪ್ರಕಾಶೋಽಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಶ್ಚ ಪ್ರಮಾದೋ ಮೋಹ ಏವ ಚ |
ತಮಸ್ಯೇತಾನಿ ಜಾಯನ್ತೇ ವಿವೃದ್ಧೇ ಕುರುನನ್ದನ ||೧೪-೧೩||

verse_translation.life_application: When darkness, inactivity, heedlessness, and delusion arise, know that ignorance is predominant.

commentary.text: 14.13 O descendant of Kuru, when Tamoguna increases, non-illumination, inactivity, heedlessness, and delusion—all these arise.
